gates.name: Native app launches
gates.evidence: ./scripts/qsb_native_cockpit_run.sh exists, executable, uses /usr/bin/python3.

gates.name: Headless instantiation works
gates.evidence: QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen test instantiates QSBNativeCockpit with 391 scene items.

gates.name: Health check uses correct engine
gates.evidence: Health check probes /usr/bin/python3, the same interpreter the run script uses. Health 28/30 (only the gates+score registries themselves were missing at the time of running).

gates.name: Screenshot proof exists
gates.evidence: data/screenshots/qsb_native_cockpit_v2.png (179KB) and qsb_native_cockpit_v3_parity.png (300KB).

gates.name: 53 floors render
gates.evidence: scene.floor_items length = 53; verified by headless test.

gates.name: 2,191 worker total verified
gates.evidence: telemetry_bridge.build_scene_snapshot().verified.verified_total_workers = 2191 = 1191 canonical + 1000 new V2.

gates.name: 9 lifts render
gates.evidence: scene.lift_cars length = 9.

gates.name: OpenClaw visible
gates.evidence: scene.openclaw_item present + scene.openclaw_label shows 'OpenClaw F30'.

gates.name: Floor selection works
gates.evidence: Click on floor slab → on_floor_clicked(n) callback verified; keyboard PgUp/PgDn/Up/Down/Home/End nav implemented.

gates.name: Worker selection works or limitation logged
gates.evidence: Individual worker clicks are NOT implemented (per phase policy — 2191 individual sprites would be label spam). Floor inspector shows team summary + room list. Limitation documented in qsb_native_missing_features_backlog.json.

gates.name: Lift selection works
gates.evidence: Click on lift car → on_lift_clicked(idx) → inspector.show_lift(L). Verified headlessly: 'Lift · main_low_rise'.

gates.name: Penthouse detail panel works
gates.evidence: Floor 55/53 click → Penthouse gauges listed from snapshot.penthouse.gauges.

gates.name: Floor 41 OANDA detail panel works
gates.evidence: F41 click → 'F41 · OANDA Practice Trading' with realized/unrealized/total PnL + open/closed counts.

gates.name: Floor 42 Binance detail panel works
gates.evidence: F42 click → 'F42 · Binance Testnet Preview' with mode + rooms + workers + real-money OFF.

gates.name: Security masked status works
gates.evidence: F28 click → 'F28 · Security Operations Center' with masked credentials + all 4 lock-off lines.

gates.name: Hardware panel works
gates.evidence: F35 click → 'F35 · Hardware Systems Floor' with cpu, cores, memory, gpu, kernel.

gates.name: Commerce Wing panel works
gates.evidence: HUD COMMERCE WING section shows wing count, shops, Etsy workers, POD workers. F6/F14 click shows Etsy/POD inspectors.

gates.name: Event ticker works
gates.evidence: QSBEventTicker dock at bottom; refresh() populates with closed trades, openclaw tickets, cadence tick, lock confirmation. Verified 9 items in headless test.

gates.name: Safety locks visible
gates.evidence: HUD SAFETY LOCKS section shows 5 red OFF rows. Verified in screenshot.

gates.name: Browser dashboard remains fallback
gates.evidence: HUD '↺ Open browser fallback' button calls webbrowser.open('http://127.0.0.1:8765/?v=next3d&floor=55'). /?v=unified and /?v=next3d both still served by server.

honest_notes: Headless GUI tests can verify widget tree + callback wiring but not actual mouse/keyboard input — those require a live display. The screenshots prove the chrome renders; clicks were exercised via direct method calls in the test.

G3 score is 28/30 in the health check because the gates and score registries themselves are emitted by the orchestrator that runs after the health check. The check script lists them as required, which creates a chicken-and-egg situation that resolves on the next run.
